hypotheses.P0_previous_operator_is_markovian: Previous-layer top-64 operator coordinates predict at least 0.50 of next-layer weighted operator-coordinate variance at Layers 1-5.
hypotheses.P1_prior_residual_is_a_compact_router: A rank-64 summary of the prior residual predicts at least 0.60 of weighted coordinates at every layer.
hypotheses.P2_attention_adds_contextual_routing: Adding a rank-64 attention-write summary improves weighted coordinate R2 by at least 0.05 over the prior residual alone at Layers 1-5.
hypotheses.P3_rank128_composed_router_recovers_half: The 64+64 prior-residual/attention router recovers at least half of the rank-64 oracle gain in total operator R2 at every layer.
hypotheses.P4_rank512_composed_router_is_near_oracl: The 256+256 prior-residual/attention router recovers at least 90 percent of the rank-64 oracle gain at every layer.
hypotheses.P5_attention_routing_grows_with_depth: The mean attention increment at Layers 4-5 exceeds that at Layers 0-1 by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.P6_direct_rank512_composition_recovers_m: Without a target-fitted decoder, adding rank-256 reconstructions of the native mixed residual and attention write recovers at least 80 percent of the rank-64 oracle gain at every layer.
hypotheses.P7_attention_pairing_is_specific: Correct residual-attention pairing beats a same-position, different-sequence attention write by at least 0.10 weighted coordinate R2 at every layer.
